---
title: "Need to Pick a Drone?"
---

This page directs users to drone recommendations organized by intended use. Select the category below that corresponds to your needs.

::: {.callout-important}
If this purchase will use federal funding, review [NDAA Compliance](ndaa-compliance.qmd) before selecting a drone. DJI and Autel products are currently restricted from federal funding under NDAA provisions.
:::

## Categories

|---|---|

| Photography or videography | [Drones for Multimedia](multimedia-drones.qmd) |
| Drones for mapping projects | [Drones for Mapping](mapping-drones.qmd) |
| Drones for federally funded projects | [NDAA-Compliant](ndaa-compliance.qmd) |
| A full comparison of all available options | [Drone Comparison Table](drone-table.qmd) |

For additional guidance, see the [New User Guide](https://ucdrones.github.io/New_User_Guide/).
